column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rule overrides (referenced by .github/workflows/security.yml).
# Policy (CLAUDE.md §18.9 task §6): do NOT relax the scan to make it pass. Every entry
# here must be a *justified* false-positive for a JSON-only API, with a reason. New
# findings are fixed at the source, never silenced by adding an IGNORE row.
# The API serves application/json only and ships no HTML, so the passive HTML/CSP
# alerts ZAP raises against the JSON error pages are not applicable. The browser CSP is
# enforced and verified separately on apps/web (threat-model §8 O3), not here.

column3: # Anti-clickjacking (X-Frame-Options) — JSON API serves no framable HTML; web app sets frame-ancestors 'none'.
# CSP header on API responses — JSON-only API; CSP is enforced on the web origin, not the API.
# X-Content-Type-Options on JSON 4xx pages — Fastify sets nosniff via helmet on real routes; error envelope is application/json.

column1: # Everything else stays at FAIL. Do not add rows without a documented justification above.
